solutionSql:
WITH heavy AS (
  SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*)::integer AS heavy_queued
  FROM shipments
  WHERE status = 'queued'
    AND weight_kg >= 1800
    AND driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT d.id AS driver_id,
       COALESCE(h.heavy_queued, 0)::integer AS heavy_queued
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN heavy AS h ON h.driver_id = d.id
ORDER BY d.id;
notes: Driver 2 has no queued shipment of 1800 kg or more, so its 0 comes from the COALESCE path.
